findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "product-admin" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_onboarding_status, list_bank_credits · Private data: connect_audience_resolver, list_audience_resolver_projects, get_webhook_secret, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: list_twitter_accounts, update_product, set_payment_config, upload_product_icon, get_webhook_secret, rotate_webhook_secret, save_alert_sources, test_parse_bank_alert · Destructive: delete_product, remove_product_icon, approve_deposit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_onboarding_status, list_bank_credits · Private data: connect_audience_resolver, list_audience_resolver_projects, get_webhook_secret, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: list_twitter_accounts, update_product, set_payment_config, upload_product_icon, get_webhook_secret, rotate_webhook_secret, save_alert_sources, test_parse_bank_alert · Destructive: delete_product, remove_product_icon, approve_deposit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
